name: Arlysia, City Docks
desc1: This road leads from the city of Arlysia to the docks of the lake. The
desc2: road has enough traffic that a few guards stand watch, keeping it safe
desc3: from danger, so that trade might continue to come in and out of the
desc4: city. Up ahead, you can see the vast waters. It seems to be tinged
desc5: with an odd shade of red.
